open: Access to the platforms (tunnel, level crossing, stairs, lifts) is unknown: DSB lists no access lines for Esbjerg and OSM has no lifts, stairs or underpass in the extract; OSM platforms carry no refs.
DSB lists 'Billetkontor' without hours; whether a staffed ticket office exists is not settled.
Identical OSM hours on five salon nodes look copied; not checked on their own sites.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.
